prompt: On the search page (app/scenes/Search), debounce the search input's change handler by 250 ms so we don't fire a request on every keystroke. Keep the change minimal. Do not run any commands or tests.
result:
Done. I've added a debounced change handler to the search input that:

1. Added a ref `searchDebounceRef` to track the debounce timeout
2. Created `handleSearchChange` callback that debounces `updateLocation` by 250ms
3. Passed the `onChange={handleSearchChange}` to SearchInput

Now search requests will only fire 250ms after the user stops typing, instead of potentially on every keystroke.
